discussion.topic: B's AB2 exposure concern and A's A-AUD-3 attribution finding
discussion.challengeOrNuance: My observation that the scrolled portrait scene lacks an adjacent owner cue does not establish that a natural visitor misses Nag's name. The name is present earlier and in the footer. Conversely, an initial 320px capture is not an exposure to the character simply because the character exists below it.
discussion.resolution: We should distinguish natural browsing from a controlled scene stimulus. For natural browsing, retain the real page and record viewport, scroll, name/moth visibility, duration and playback; report unequal exposure instead of attributing it to theme or character quality. For a self-contained attribution stimulus, an adjacent verified Nag/first-person cue is an optional comparison variable, not an automatic fix and not a new result. As B emphasized in the direct exchange, branded attribution/recall exposure must retain the name and project context: removing those to mimic an isolated neutral action clip would test the wrong thing. Keep A's 0.4 craft deduction and B's instrument limit visible without claiming measured misattribution.

discussion.topic: B's AB3 sharing cue and A's A-AUD-1 still-family finding
discussion.challengeOrNuance: A tiny hand's visibility is not the same as its social meaning. Equally, resemblance between Grateful/Shy or Thinking/Focused stills is not observed confusion and does not justify demanding perfect identification of all 24 labels.
discussion.resolution: Keep the present anatomy and owner-selected direction. Prioritize the consequential narrative distinction in its intended application: investigating and offering something versus merely looking/thinking. For any future human work, accept unconstrained descriptions before coding responses; do not supply 'sharing' as the expected answer. Use the quiet-pose family observation to select useful comparisons, not to preemptively enlarge hands, add explanation or rewrite the repertoire.

discussion.resolution: Accept the v2 limitation explicitly. Portrait legibility improves while the eye-to-question relation remains less literal. Preserve it as a nonblocking craft issue for the local foundation; future staging tests may vary orientation or position within the same anatomy. steps: Before any future comparison, name the decision: owner preference, expert craft, usability, comprehension or memory. Do not reuse one score across these questions.

Apply prototype's realistic full-size presentation and named comparison axis. Keep a single working direction visible, immediate switching for expert comparison, and the already selected owner direction stable. The existing historical evidence remains preserved.

For comprehension, separate the authoring tool from the neutral stimulus. Version the exact source, theme, size, exposure duration, playback/still state, motion preference and viewport/scroll. Free description precedes diagnostic labels; any later comparison order is handled explicitly.

For attribution and memory, separate recall of the visual, recall of heyNag, association between them, and recall of software work. Unaided recall precedes recognition choices. No human outcome is filled from AI agreement.

Apply emil-design-eng's purpose/frequency guidance to immediate control feedback. Preserve purposeful character beats and keyboard Play. Any cue adjustment gets actual-size rendered comparison, with a Before/After/Why explanation.

Apply mobile-native by capability and reason. Keep zoom, document scrolling and selectable content; classify source/emulation observations separately from phone tests. Do not call phone behavior validated without hardware evidence.
exceptions: No new prototype run, picker, source mutation, recruitment or extra owner-selection gate is authorized by this review alone.
Prototype cleanup does not delete historical evidence required by the repository.
Sub-300ms UI timing and no keyboard animation do not truncate intentional character content or disable accessible Play.
Compositor guidance does not justify deleting expressive SVG anatomy; performance changes require a relevant workload and diagnosis.
A mobile baseline is not a reason to lock zoom, suppress content selection or disable scrolling across a document.

remainingEvidenceLimits: No new unfamiliar-human results, actual attribution, delayed recall or attachment evidence.
No continuous normal-speed playback observation by this reviewer; decoded frames and deterministic films establish different claims.
No physical-phone behavior, GPU trace, native-menu keyboard commit or spoken screen-reader output established.
No source changes or public release action in this pair phase.
